sections.overall: For only the third time this year, Collision was rated higher than Dynamite (8.18 to 6.16). The Saturday show, Night 2 of the Summer Blockbuster, also featured the top match of the week: the Cincinnati Street Fight between the Death Riders and STP (8.24), leading to decent gains for all involved.  Not many gains on Dynamite, nor many other big ratings stories this week.
sections.mens: Jon Moxley featured in two matches this week. The former, on Dynamite, was a disappointing Continental Title match against Shane Taylor (5.74). Is Mox being over-exposed? Kevin Knight vs Myron Reed for the TNT Title ended up as the top men's match of the week (7.41).
sections.womens: Although there were three women's singles matches this week, none hit the same heights as last week's. The top-rated was Maya World vs Skye Blue, another Owen Hart Tournament bout. I really hope that Skye now doesn't have to wait a few weeks for her next chance to show what she can do.
sections.menstag: The Dogs vs The Young Bucks was an enjoyable affair, though not up to the lofty standards of the #1 AEW tag team, which is why they did not gain anything.
sections.womenstag: No matches in the Women's Tag division this week. Hopefully we will get some much-needed ones soon.
sections.trios: No Trios matches this week. Although the two factions in the main event have had Trio combinations, no definitive ones were eligible for counting matches. In factions like Death Riders and STP, there have been multiple combinations within them - so no regular Trio that could qualify.
